editorial.blurb: Chef Grant Achatz's completely reimagined tasting menu at Alinea remains one of Chicago's most theatrical and ambitious dining experiences, balancing innovative technique with newfound playfulness.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the chef's table for the most immersive experience—watching the kitchen operate in near darkness and seeing courses meticulously plated adds an entirely new dimension to the evening.
signatureDishes: Japanese Wagyu course inspired by Caravaggio's Saint Jerome Writing
